description: Register a payment against a posted Odoo customer invoice. Creates, posts, and reconciles an account.payment via the account.payment.register wizard. Never auto-posts invoices. Prevents overpayment, negative amounts, and payments on draft or already-paid invoices.

invoice_number.description: Invoice number as displayed in Odoo (e.g. INV/2026/00001). Must match a posted customer invoice.

amount.description: Payment amount in the invoice's currency. Must be greater than 0 and must not exceed the invoice outstanding balance.

journal_name.description: Name of the accounting journal to use for the payment. Must be a Cash or Bank type journal. Defaults to 'Cash' if not provided.

invoice.description: The invoice number payment was applied to

remaining_balance.description: Invoice outstanding balance after payment (2dp precision)

errorCodes.invalid_amount: amount is zero, negative, or not a number
errorCodes.invoice_not_found: No posted customer invoice matches the given invoice_number
errorCodes.invoice_not_posted: Invoice found but is in draft/cancelled state (should not occur due to domain filter; kept as explicit guard)
errorCodes.overpayment_not_allowed: amount exceeds the invoice outstanding balance (amount_residual)
errorCodes.journal_not_found: No cash/bank journal matches the given journal_name

idempotency: NOT idempotent. Each call creates a new payment record in Odoo. Callers must check invoice payment_state via list_unpaid_invoices before retrying.
sideEffects: Posts the payment (transitions from draft to posted state)
Reconciles payment against invoice (reduces invoice amount_residual)
Appends entry to Vault daily log file
nonGoals: Does not support vendor bill payments (in_invoice)
Does not support payment reversal or deletion
